ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) central surface with high-intensity (light gray/white) margins; estimated ratio of 80% low-intensity to 20% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous low-intensity mass. High-intensity mottling and focal patches localized at the distal tips (left and right) and intermittent clusters along the trailing edge margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide-angle V-shaped notch, approximately 140 degrees, with low vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys ranging from approximately 3 to 12 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to an upward-oriented curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters visible on the outer margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentation on the inner portion of the right lobe's trailing edge, distinct from the uniform serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical distal tip geometry; the right lobe terminates in a sharper, more vertically elongated peak compared to the left lobe.
